title: Mean field error estimate of the random batch method for vortex blob dynamics for the 2D Navier--Stokes Equation
summary: We propose and analyze the random batch vortex blob method for the 2D Navier--Stokes equation in vorticity form on the whole plane. The vortex blob method is based on an interacting particle system of $N$ particles with computational complexity of $O(N^2)$, which is reduced to $O(N)$ by the random batch method \cite{JinLiLiu2020}. Our main result is a quantitative law level mean field error estimate whose dependence on the blob radius remains algebraic. We treat the two main error mechanisms separately.
